title: Jensen Huang scheduled to testify next week in Senate following reinstatement as Nvidia CEO
lede: Jensen Huang is due to testify publicly before the Senate Banking Committee on December 3, a hearing set hours after Nvidia reinstated him as chief executive.

points: The date comes from a notice posted on the committee's website.
Huang resigned less than two weeks earlier, after it emerged he had at least two extramarital affairs, one with a woman US officials suspect of spying for China.
Senators from both parties had called for him to answer questions about that relationship and any part in chip smuggling.
The committee oversees export controls meant to keep sensitive US technology, including AI chips, from foreign governments and militaries.
Before his return, Huang had already agreed to appear on December 1 before House Foreign Affairs, House Intelligence and the Select Committee on the CCP.

sections.text: The hearing is before the committee responsible for export-control policy on AI chips, the rules that decide where Nvidia's accelerators can legally be sold.
